The four chorale entries are NOT within Leipzig Eighteen despite source heading.
BWV243a, BWV245 versions, BWV1019 versions, BWV249a and BWV249b relations non-transitive.
BWV248 parts represented as documentary parts, not six unrelated canonical compositions.
Work movements in BWV1080, BWV1079, BWV1004 documentary components, not independent certified works.
